speaker: Doctor
text:
The renal ultrasound findings of multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts, combined with hematuria and flank pain, are highly indicative of Medullary Sponge Kidney. Given the negative cytology and normal bladder exam, malignancy is unlikely.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney
